::: {.callout-note}
## How to use this chart
Click any node to see detailed explanations and Stan code references (look for the **ⓘ** marker).
Click the node again or the chart background to close. Two pathways run in parallel per draw:

- **spop** (super-population) — unconditional draw; fresh independent sample per patient. Used for population-level KM / CIF curves.
- **sample** (posterior predictive) — conditioned on observed data; observed events are reused, forecasts extend from the last observation. Used for calibration checks.
:::

All seven sections run inside a single per-patient loop in `sample_gq_endpoints()` in
`stan/modules/state_space/sf.stanfunctions`.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
d3 = require("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3@7/dist/d3.min.js")
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
renderFlowchart = {
  let _counter = 0;

  return function(nodes, edges, title, W, H) {
    const uid = "fc" + (++_counter);
    const nodeMap = new Map(nodes.map(n => [n.id, n]));

    const palette = {
      process:  {fill: "#eff6ff", stroke: "#2563eb", text: "#1e3a5f"},
      decision: {fill: "#fffbeb", stroke: "#d97706", text: "#78350f"},
      event:    {fill: "#fef2f2", stroke: "#dc2626", text: "#7f1d1d"},
      censored: {fill: "#f0fdf4", stroke: "#16a34a", text: "#14532d"},
      update:   {fill: "#faf5ff", stroke: "#7c3aed", text: "#4c1d95"},
    };
    const edgeColors = {yes: "#d97706", no: "#1d4ed8", normal: "#64748b"};

    const svg = d3.create("svg")
      .attr("viewBox", `0 0 ${W} ${H}`)
      .attr("width", "100%")
      .style("font-family", "'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif")
      .style("background", "linear-gradient(135deg, #f8fafc 0%, #f1f5f9 100%)")
      .style("border-radius", "10px")
      .style("border", "1px solid #e2e8f0")
      .style("cursor", "default");

    // Defs: arrowheads + drop shadow
    const defs = svg.append("defs");
    for (const [key, color] of Object.entries(edgeColors)) {
      defs.append("marker")
        .attr("id", `ah-${key}-${uid}`)
        .attr("viewBox", "0 0 10 7").attr("refX", 9).attr("refY", 3.5)
        .attr("markerWidth", 8).attr("markerHeight", 6).attr("orient", "auto")
        .append("polygon").attr("points", "0 0, 10 3.5, 0 7").attr("fill", color);
    }
    const flt = defs.append("filter").attr("id", `sh-${uid}`)
      .attr("x", "-5%").attr("y", "-5%").attr("width", "115%").attr("height", "130%");
    flt.append("feDropShadow").attr("dx", 0).attr("dy", 2).attr("stdDeviation", 3)
      .attr("flood-color", "#000").attr("flood-opacity", 0.07);

    // Title
    svg.append("text").attr("x", W / 2).attr("y", 22)
      .attr("text-anchor", "middle").attr("font-size", 15).attr("font-weight", "bold")
      .attr("fill", "#003865").text(title);

    // Column labels + divider for two-column layouts
    const xs = nodes.map(n => n.x);
    const hasLeft  = xs.some(x => x < 500);
    const hasRight = xs.some(x => x > 600);
    if (hasLeft && hasRight) {
      svg.append("line")
        .attr("x1", W / 2).attr("y1", 32).attr("x2", W / 2).attr("y2", H - 8)
        .attr("stroke", "#e2e8f0").attr("stroke-width", 1).attr("stroke-dasharray", "4,3");
      svg.append("text").attr("x", W / 4).attr("y", 42)
        .attr("text-anchor", "middle").attr("font-size", 11.5).attr("font-weight", "600")
        .attr("fill", "#2563eb").text("spop (unconditional)");
      svg.append("text").attr("x", 3 * W / 4).attr("y", 42)
        .attr("text-anchor", "middle").attr("font-size", 11.5).attr("font-weight", "600")
        .attr("fill", "#7c3aed").text("sample (posterior predictive)");
    }

    // Edge routing
    function routeEdge(e) {
      if (e.path) return e.path;
      const f = nodeMap.get(e.from), t = nodeMap.get(e.to);
      const fR = f.x + f.w / 2, fL = f.x - f.w / 2;
      const fB = f.y + f.h / 2, tT = t.y - t.h / 2;
      const tR = t.x + t.w / 2, tL = t.x - t.w / 2;
      if (e.type === "normal" || e.type === "no") {
        return `M ${f.x},${fB} L ${t.x},${tT}`;
      }
      if (e.type === "yes") {
        if (Math.abs(t.x - f.x) < 10) return `M ${f.x},${fB} L ${t.x},${tT}`;
        if (t.x > f.x) {
          if (Math.abs(t.y - f.y) < 5) return `M ${fR},${f.y} H ${tL}`;
          const mx = (fR + tL) / 2;
          return `M ${fR},${f.y} H ${mx} V ${t.y} H ${tL}`;
        }
        // Left exit
        if (Math.abs(t.y - f.y) < 5) return `M ${fL},${f.y} H ${tR}`;
        const mx = (fL + tR) / 2;
        return `M ${fL},${f.y} H ${mx} V ${t.y} H ${tR}`;
      }
      return `M ${f.x},${fB} L ${t.x},${tT}`;
    }

    // Edge label position
    function labelPos(e) {
      if (e.path) {
        const pts = [...e.path.matchAll(/(\d+(?:\.\d+)?),(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/g)]
          .map(m => [+m[1], +m[2]]);
        if (pts.length >= 2) {
          const mid = Math.floor((pts.length - 1) / 2);
          return {x: pts[mid][0] + 6, y: pts[mid][1] - 7};
        }
        const f = nodeMap.get(e.from);
        return {x: f.x + 14, y: f.y + f.h / 2 + 14};
      }
      const f = nodeMap.get(e.from), t = nodeMap.get(e.to);
      if (e.type === "yes") {
        if (t.x > f.x + 10) return {x: f.x + f.w / 2 + 12, y: f.y - 6};
        if (t.x < f.x - 10) return {x: f.x - f.w / 2 - 22, y: f.y - 6};
        return {x: f.x + 14, y: f.y + f.h / 2 + 14};
      }
      if (e.type === "no") return {x: f.x + 12, y: f.y + f.h / 2 + 14};
      return null;
    }

    // Draw edges
    const eg = svg.append("g");
    for (const e of edges) {
      const color = edgeColors[e.type] || edgeColors.normal;
      const marker = `url(#ah-${e.type || "normal"}-${uid})`;
      const pathStr = routeEdge(e);
      eg.append("path").attr("d", pathStr)
        .attr("fill", "none").attr("stroke", color).attr("stroke-width", 1.8)
        .attr("marker-end", marker);
      if (e.label) {
        const lp = labelPos(e);
        if (lp) {
          const tw = e.label.length * 7 + 10;
          eg.append("rect")
            .attr("x", lp.x - tw / 2).attr("y", lp.y - 9)
            .attr("width", tw).attr("height", 15).attr("rx", 3)
            .attr("fill",   e.type === "yes" ? "#fef3c7" : e.type === "no" ? "#dbeafe" : "#f1f5f9")
            .attr("stroke", e.type === "yes" ? "#f59e0b" : e.type === "no" ? "#93c5fd" : "#cbd5e1")
            .attr("stroke-width", 0.5);
          eg.append("text")
            .attr("x", lp.x).attr("y", lp.y + 1)
            .attr("text-anchor", "middle").attr("dominant-baseline", "middle")
            .attr("font-size", 10).attr("font-weight", "bold")
            .attr("fill", e.type === "yes" ? "#92400e" : e.type === "no" ? "#1e40af" : "#475569")
            .text(e.label);
        }
      }
    }

    // Detail panel (shared across all charts via CSS class)
    const panel = d3.select("body").append("div")
      .attr("class", "fc-detail-panel")
      .style("position", "absolute").style("display", "none")
      .style("background", "white").style("border", "1px solid #cbd5e1")
      .style("border-left", "4px solid #6366f1").style("border-radius", "8px")
      .style("padding", "14px 18px").style("font-size", "12px").style("line-height", "1.65")
      .style("max-width", "400px").style("box-shadow", "0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.18)")
      .style("z-index", "9999").style("pointer-events", "auto");

    let activeId = null;

    // Draw nodes
    const ng = svg.append("g");
    for (const n of nodes) {
      const c = palette[n.type] || palette.process;
      const g = ng.append("g").style("cursor", "pointer");

      g.append("rect")
        .attr("x", n.x - n.w / 2).attr("y", n.y - n.h / 2)
        .attr("width", n.w).attr("height", n.h)
        .attr("rx", n.type === "decision" ? 4 : 7)
        .attr("fill", c.fill).attr("stroke", c.stroke)
        .attr("stroke-width", n.type === "decision" ? 2 : 1.5)
        .attr("filter", `url(#sh-${uid})`);

      const lines = n.label.split("\n");
      const sublines = n.sublabel ? n.sublabel.split("\n") : [];
      const totalLines = lines.length + sublines.length;
      let ty = n.y - (totalLines * 7.5) + 8;

      for (const l of lines) {
        g.append("text").attr("x", n.x).attr("y", ty)
          .attr("text-anchor", "middle").attr("dominant-baseline", "middle")
          .attr("font-size", 12).attr("font-weight", "bold").attr("fill", c.text)
          .text(l);
        ty += 15;
      }
      if (sublines.length) { ty += 1; }
      for (const sl of sublines) {
        g.append("text").attr("x", n.x).attr("y", ty)
          .attr("text-anchor", "middle").attr("dominant-baseline", "middle")
          .attr("font-size", 10.5).attr("fill", c.text).attr("opacity", 0.72)
          .text(sl);
        ty += 13;
      }

      if (n.detail) {
        g.append("text")
          .attr("x", n.x + n.w / 2 - 10).attr("y", n.y - n.h / 2 + 11)
          .attr("font-size", 9.5).attr("fill", c.stroke).attr("opacity", 0.5)
          .text("ⓘ");
      }

      g.on("mouseenter", function() {
        d3.select(this).select("rect").transition().duration(80).attr("stroke-width", 3);
      }).on("mouseleave", function() {
        d3.select(this).select("rect").transition().duration(80)
          .attr("stroke-width", n.type === "decision" ? 2 : 1.5);
      }).on("click", function(event) {
        event.stopPropagation();
        if (activeId === n.id) {
          panel.style("display", "none"); activeId = null; return;
        }
        d3.selectAll(".fc-detail-panel").style("display", "none");
        activeId = n.id;

        const detailHtml = (n.detail || "").split("\n").map(l =>
          l.startsWith("•") ? `<div style="margin-left:10px">${l}</div>`
          : l.trim() === "" ? "<br/>"
          : `<div>${l}</div>`
        ).join("");

        const codeHtml = n.code
          ? n.code.split("\n").map(ref =>
              `<div style="color:#6366f1;font-family:monospace;font-size:11px;">📍 ${ref}</div>`
            ).join("")
          : "";

        panel.html(`
          <div style="font-weight:bold;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:6px;color:#1e293b">
            ${n.label.replace(/\n/g, " ")}
          </div>
          <div>${detailHtml}</div>
          ${codeHtml ? `<div style="margin-top:8px;padding-top:6px;border-top:1px solid #e2e8f0">${codeHtml}</div>` : ""}
          <div style="margin-top:6px;font-size:10px;color:#94a3b8">Click node again or background to close</div>
        `)
        .style("left", (event.pageX + 14) + "px")
        .style("top",  (event.pageY - 16) + "px")
        .style("display", "block");
      });
    }

    svg.on("click", () => { panel.style("display", "none"); activeId = null; });
    return svg.node();
  };
}
```

## 1. Target PFS {#sec-target-pfs}

RECIST-derived progression from target lesions. The **spop** path always forecasts using the full assessment schedule; the **sample** path uses observed data directly when a PFS event was recorded.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

chart1 = {
  const nodes = [
    // ── spop column ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    {id:"p1", x:240, y:108, w:330, h:60, type:"process",
     label:"Build full RECIST schedule",
     sublabel:"rep_recist ++ forecast_obs_recist",
     detail:"Concatenates two arrays:\n• rep_recist[treat_visit_start:visit_end] — observed treatment-visit RECIST states\n• forecast_obs_recist[assess_start:assess_end] — predicted RECIST at future assessment visits\n\nThe combined schedule covers both the observed period and the forecast horizon. Assessment visits are spaced at forecast_observation_interval weeks.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1424–1431"},

    {id:"p2", x:240, y:215, w:330, h:60, type:"process",
     label:"find_first_week({PD}, n=1)",
     sublabel:"across treat_visits + obs_visit_time",
     detail:"Searches full_predict_recist for the first PD state (code 4), requiring n=1 consecutive confirmation. Also computes treat_curr_visits (observed) and obs_visit_time (forecast schedule) for the search.\n\nIf no PD is found, returns max_all_t + 1 with right_censored = 1.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1443–1444"},

    {id:"p3", x:240, y:365, w:330, h:70, type:"event",
     label:"spop_target_pfs[i]",
     sublabel:"spop_target_right_censored[i]\nAlso: response indicators, obs-cens variant",
     detail:"Output: unconditional target-lesion PFS time.\n\nAdditionally computes:\n• spop_target_confirmed_response[i] — confirmed CR/PR (2 consecutive)\n• spop_target_unconfirmed_response[i] — first CR/PR before PFS event\n• spop_target_obs_cens_pfs[i] = min(spop_target_pfs[i], target_pfs[i]) — bounded by observed censoring time",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1443–1495"},

    // ── sample column ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    {id:"sd", x:750, y:105, w:310, h:60, type:"decision",
     label:"target_right_censored[i]?",
     sublabel:"patient censored for target-lesion PFS?",
     detail:"Checks whether the patient's target-lesion PFS is right-censored (no observed PD event). Censored patients need a forecast; observed progressors use their deterministic event time directly.\n\nNote: this is target_right_censored, not the overall combined right_censored. A patient censored for target-lesion PFS may still have a multistate PFS event.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1454"},

    {id:"sy1", x:750, y:218, w:310, h:60, type:"process",
     label:"Build combined RECIST",
     sublabel:"obs_recist ++ forecast_obs_recist",
     detail:"For censored patients, builds a combined array: observed RECIST states from treatment visits, followed by predicted RECIST at future assessment visits. This extends the search horizon beyond the last observation.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1456–1458"},

    {id:"sy2", x:750, y:318, w:310, h:55, type:"process",
     label:"find_first_week({PD}, n=1)",
     sublabel:"combined observed + forecast schedule",
     detail:"Same search as the spop path, but over the combined observed + forecast schedule. For censored patients this forecasts when progression might occur after the last observation. Saves to forecast_target_pfs for the forecast-specific output array.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1459–1463"},

    {id:"sy3", x:750, y:405, w:310, h:60, type:"event",
     label:"sample_target_pfs[i]",
     sublabel:"sample_target_right_censored[i]",
     detail:"Output: sample (conditional) target-lesion PFS time and censoring indicator. Also computes sample_target_confirmed_response and sample_target_unconfirmed_response from the same combined RECIST sequence.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1459–1492"},

    {id:"sn", x:1020, y:195, w:170, h:60, type:"event",
     label:"= target_pfs[i]",
     sublabel:"observed, deterministic",
     detail:"For patients with an observed target-lesion PFS event, the sample path simply reuses the observed time. No forecast is needed.\n\nsample_target_pfs[i] = target_pfs[i]\nsample_target_right_censored[i] = target_right_censored[i] = 0\n\nResponse indicators are computed from the raw observed RECIST sequence.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1475–1476"},
  ];

  const edges = [
    {from:"p1", to:"p2", type:"normal"},
    {from:"p2", to:"p3", type:"normal"},
    {from:"sd", to:"sy1", type:"yes", label:"yes", path:`M 750,135 V 188`},
    {from:"sd", to:"sn",  type:"no",  label:"no",  path:`M 905,105 H 1020 V 165`},
    {from:"sy1", to:"sy2", type:"normal"},
    {from:"sy2", to:"sy3", type:"normal"},
  ];

  return renderFlowchart(nodes, edges, "1. Target PFS — RECIST-derived progression", 1100, 450);
}
```

## 2. Multistate PFS {#sec-ms-pfs}

Hazard-driven PFS via the assessment-gated survival sampler. The **spop** path samples unconditionally; the **sample** path conditions on whether an ms event was actually observed.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

chart2 = {
  const nodes = [
    // ── spop column ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    {id:"q1", x:240, y:120, w:340, h:75, type:"process",
     label:"assessment_gated_survival_time_rng",
     sublabel:"unconditional — fresh draw\nvisit schedule: treat_visits + obs_visit_time",
     detail:"Samples a 0→1 transition time by accumulating hazard across the assessment visit schedule. Uses ms_log_cond_surv[i] — the log conditional survival for each weekly interval.\n\nThe function steps through the visit schedule, at each visit testing whether the cumulative hazard triggers an event. Unlike a continuous-time process, events can only be detected at assessment visits.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1513–1514"},

    {id:"q2", x:240, y:300, w:340, h:65, type:"event",
     label:"spop_ms_pfs[i]",
     sublabel:"spop_ms_right_censored[i]",
     detail:"Output: unconditional multistate-hazard PFS time.\n\nNote: assessment_gated_survival_time_rng returns a 1-indexed calendar week directly (no +1 correction needed, unlike the raw survival_time_rng).",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1513–1515"},

    // ── sample column ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    {id:"rd", x:760, y:115, w:310, h:60, type:"decision",
     label:"ms_right_censored[i]?",
     sublabel:"No 0→1 ms event observed?",
     detail:"Checks if the multistate 0→1 transition is censored. Patients can be censored if: they had no PFS event by the DCO, they dropped out (state 3), or they died directly (0→2) — in all these cases ms_right_censored = 1 and we need to forecast the 0→1 time.\n\nNote: progression observed via target lesions (target_right_censored=0) but NOT via the ms model (ms_right_censored=1) is the typical case — most progressors are detected by RECIST, not by the ms hazard.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1500–1509"},

    {id:"ry", x:760, y:228, w:310, h:70, type:"process",
     label:"assessment_gated_survival_time_rng",
     sublabel:"conditional — forecast from pfs[i]\nskip visits before pfs[i]",
     detail:"For censored patients, forecasts a potential ms event starting from the observed censoring time pfs[i]. The skip_before argument causes the function to ignore all visits before week pfs[i], so the forecast begins from the last known alive-without-progression time.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1503–1504"},

    {id:"ro", x:760, y:348, w:310, h:65, type:"event",
     label:"sample_ms_pfs[i]",
     sublabel:"sample_ms_right_censored[i]",
     detail:"Output: conditional multistate-hazard PFS time. For censored patients this is the forecasted first ms event time; for observed patients it is pfs[i] exactly.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1503–1509"},

    {id:"rn", x:1020, y:200, w:165, h:65, type:"event",
     label:"= pfs[i]",
     sublabel:"sample_ms_right_censored = 0\n(ms event observed)",
     detail:"When ms_right_censored[i] = 0, a 0→1 multistate event was actually recorded. The sample path simply uses the observed pfs[i] (which equals the detection week) and marks censored = 0.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1507–1508"},
  ];

  const edges = [
    {from:"q1", to:"q2", type:"normal"},
    {from:"rd", to:"ry", type:"yes", label:"yes", path:`M 760,145 V 193`},
    {from:"rd", to:"rn", type:"no",  label:"no",  path:`M 915,115 H 1020 V 167`},
    {from:"ry", to:"ro", type:"normal"},
  ];

  return renderFlowchart(nodes, edges, "2. Multistate PFS — assessment-gated hazard", 1100, 400);
}
```

## 3. Combined PFS {#sec-combined-pfs}

Combines target-lesion and multistate PFS into the final clinical PFS endpoint.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

chart3 = {
  const nodes = [
    // ── spop column ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    {id:"c1", x:240, y:112, w:340, h:68, type:"process",
     label:"spop_pfs = min(spop_target_pfs, spop_ms_pfs)",
     sublabel:"censored iff both components censored",
     detail:"Takes the minimum of the two unconditional PFS times. Either component can 'fire' first:\n• spop_target_pfs — first RECIST PD from the SLD trajectory\n• spop_ms_pfs — first 0→1 transition from the multistate hazard\n\nRight-censored if AND only if both components are censored (neither found an event within max_all_t).",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1529–1530"},

    {id:"c2", x:240, y:295, w:340, h:65, type:"event",
     label:"spop_pfs[i]",
     sublabel:"spop_right_censored[i]",
     detail:"Output: unconditional combined PFS. This is the primary spop endpoint used for population-level KM curves. Note: direct death (0→2) and dropout (0→3) will retroactively update this value in Section 5.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1529–1531"},

    // ── sample column ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    {id:"cd", x:760, y:107, w:310, h:60, type:"decision",
     label:"right_censored[i]?",
     sublabel:"No combined PFS event observed?",
     detail:"Checks if the overall PFS is censored. right_censored = 1 means the patient had no progression AND no on-trial death by their last observation time. Such patients need a combined forecast.\n\nIf right_censored = 0, a PFS event was already recorded in the data (progression or on-trial death) and the sample path uses the exact event time.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1518–1531"},

    {id:"cy", x:760, y:220, w:310, h:65, type:"process",
     label:"sample_pfs = min(sample_target_pfs, sample_ms_pfs)",
     sublabel:"censored iff both components censored",
     detail:"For censored patients, combines the two conditional forecasts. Both components may still be censored if neither predicts an event within the observation window.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1524–1525"},

    {id:"co", x:760, y:330, w:310, h:65, type:"event",
     label:"sample_pfs[i]",
     sublabel:"sample_right_censored[i]",
     detail:"Output: conditional combined PFS. Used for calibration KM plots against observed data. Note: direct death and dropout will retroactively update this in Section 5.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1524–1526"},

    {id:"cn", x:1020, y:193, w:165, h:60, type:"event",
     label:"= pfs[i]",
     sublabel:"sample_right_censored = 0\n(PFS event observed)",
     detail:"When the combined PFS event was observed (right_censored = 0), the sample path uses the exact observed pfs[i]. This covers both RECIST PD (detected by target lesion) and on-trial death without progression (0→2 event).",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1519–1521"},
  ];

  const edges = [
    {from:"c1", to:"c2", type:"normal"},
    {from:"cd", to:"cy", type:"yes", label:"yes", path:`M 760,137 V 187`},
    {from:"cd", to:"cn", type:"no",  label:"no",  path:`M 915,107 H 1020 V 163`},
    {from:"cy", to:"co", type:"normal"},
  ];

  return renderFlowchart(nodes, edges, "3. Combined PFS — min(target, multistate)", 1100, 410);
}
```

## 4. OS Simulation {#sec-os}

### 4a. spop OS — unconditional competing risks {#sec-spop-os}

All three state-0 exits (0→1 progression, 0→2 direct death, 0→3 dropout) are sampled from scratch. The first to fire determines the OS pathway.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

chart4a = {
  const nodes = [
    {id:"a_in", x:440, y:60, w:520, h:68, type:"process",
     label:"Sample all competing risks from state 0",
     sublabel:"T₀₁ = spop_pfs[i]   T₀₂ ~ survival_time_rng(λ₀₂)   T₀₃ ~ survival_time_rng(λ₀₃)",
     detail:"Three independent competing risks sampled:\n• T₀₁ = spop_pfs[i] — combined PFS from sections 1–3 (already computed)\n• T₀₂ ~ survival_time_rng(log_cond_surv_02[i]) — direct death from 0→2 hazard. Only if enable_ms_02. Result is 0-indexed → +1.\n• T₀₃ ~ survival_time_rng(log_cond_surv_03[i]) — dropout from 0→3 hazard. Only if enable_ms_03.\n\nIf a transition is disabled, its time defaults to max_all_t + 1 (effectively infinite).",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1538–1557"},

    {id:"a_pri", x:440, y:162, w:520, h:50, type:"process",
     label:"Determine first state-0 exit",
     sublabel:"Tie priority: 0→1 > 0→2 > 0→3",
     detail:"Three boolean flags are computed with careful tie-breaking:\n• progressed_first: !cens_01 && (cens_02 || T₀₁ ≤ T₀₂) && (cens_03 || T₀₁ ≤ T₀₃)\n• died_directly:    !cens_02 && (cens_01 || T₀₂ < T₀₁) && (cens_03 || T₀₂ ≤ T₀₃)\n• dropped_out:      !cens_03 && (cens_01 || T₀₃ < T₀₁) && (cens_02 || T₀₃ < T₀₂)\n\nProgression uses ≤ (wins ties). Death uses < against progression but ≤ against dropout. Dropout uses strict < against both — always loses ties.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1561–1569"},

    {id:"a_dd", x:440, y:268, w:390, h:60, type:"decision",
     label:"spop_died_directly?",
     sublabel:"0→2 fires first",
     detail:"Checks: enable_ms_02 && !spop_cens_02 && T₀₂ beats T₀₁ and T₀₃.\nThis is the first branch in the if-else cascade. If true, OS is immediately resolved at T₀₂.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1564–1566, 1571–1574"},

    {id:"a_dd_yes", x:820, y:268, w:230, h:60, type:"event",
     label:"Direct death (0→2)",
     sublabel:"OS = T₀₂, not censored",
     detail:"spop_os[i] = spop_time_02\nspop_os_censored[i] = 0\n\nAfter this, PFS is retroactively updated in Section 5:\n• spop_ms_pfs ← T₀₂, censored ← 0\n• spop_pfs = min(target_pfs, T₀₂)",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1571–1574"},

    {id:"a_do", x:440, y:388, w:390, h:60, type:"decision",
     label:"spop_dropped_out?",
     sublabel:"0→3 fires first",
     detail:"Checks: enable_ms_03 && !spop_cens_03 && T₀₃ strictly less than both T₀₁ and T₀₂.\nDropout uses strict < against both → it always loses ties.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1567–1569"},

    {id:"a_en32", x:820, y:388, w:230, h:55, type:"decision",
     label:"enable_ms_32?",
     sublabel:"3→2 transition modeled?",
     detail:"Is the 3→2 transition (off-trial death after dropout) being modeled? If yes, sample post-dropout survival unconditionally (sojourn_obs=0). If no, OS is censored at the dropout week.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1575–1582"},

    {id:"a_32y", x:730, y:498, w:265, h:68, type:"event",
     label:"sample_dropout_death_rng",
     sublabel:"unconditional (sojourn_obs=0)\nOS = T₀₃ + sojourn + 1",
     detail:"(spop_os[i], spop_os_censored[i]) = sample_dropout_death_rng(log_cond_surv_32[i], spop_time_03, 0)\n\nsamples from the 3→2 sojourn GP. sojourn_obs=0 = unconditional.\nIf sojourn exceeds GP horizon, OS is censored.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1577–1578"},

    {id:"a_32n", x:970, y:498, w:205, h:60, type:"censored",
     label:"No 3→2 model",
     sublabel:"OS = T₀₃, censored",
     detail:"spop_os[i] = spop_time_03\nspop_os_censored[i] = 1\n\nWithout a 3→2 model, OS is censored at the dropout week.\n\nPFS updated in Section 5:\n• spop_ms_pfs ← T₀₃, censored ← 1\n• If SLD PD ≤ T₀₃: PFS = SLD PD (event)\n• Else: PFS = T₀₃ (censored)",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1579–1582"},

    {id:"a_pr", x:440, y:640, w:390, h:60, type:"decision",
     label:"spop_progressed_first? && enable_ms_12",
     sublabel:"0→1 fires first AND 1→2 modeled",
     detail:"This branch fires when:\n1. Progression (0→1) was the first state-0 exit, AND\n2. The 1→2 (post-progression death) transition is enabled.\n\nGuard: when ms_time_scale_12==1 (semi-Markov), log_cond_surv_12_t has zero columns. Code checks cols() > 0 before access.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1583–1590"},

    {id:"a_pr_yes", x:820, y:640, w:265, h:75, type:"event",
     label:"sample_post_progression_death_rng",
     sublabel:"unconditional (sojourn_obs=0)\nMarkov / semi-Markov / extended",
     detail:"(spop_os[i], spop_os_censored[i]) = sample_post_progression_death_rng(\n  ms_time_scale_12, log_cond_surv_12_s[i], log_cond_surv_12_t[i], spop_time_01, 0)\n\nThree time-scale modes:\n• 0 (Markov): clock-forward GP — calendar time\n• 1 (Semi-Markov): sojourn GP — time since progression\n• 2 (Extended): additive combination of both\n\nsojourn_obs=0 = unconditional.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1586–1590"},

    {id:"a_ac", x:440, y:765, w:390, h:60, type:"censored",
     label:"All censored",
     sublabel:"OS = max(T₀₁, T₀₂, T₀₃), censored",
     detail:"spop_os[i] = max({spop_time_01, spop_time_02, spop_time_03})\nspop_os_censored[i] = 1\n\nAlso catches: progressed_first = 1 but enable_ms_12 = 0 — progression occurred but post-PD death is not modeled.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1591–1595"},
  ];

  const edges = [
    {from:"a_in",  to:"a_pri",    type:"normal"},
    {from:"a_pri", to:"a_dd",     type:"normal"},
    {from:"a_dd",  to:"a_dd_yes", type:"yes",  label:"yes"},
    {from:"a_dd",  to:"a_do",     type:"no",   label:"no"},
    {from:"a_do",  to:"a_en32",   type:"yes",  label:"yes"},
    {from:"a_do",  to:"a_pr",     type:"no",   label:"no"},
    {from:"a_en32",to:"a_32y",    type:"yes",  label:"yes",
      path:`M 790,416 V 442 H 730 V 464`},
    {from:"a_en32",to:"a_32n",    type:"no",   label:"no",
      path:`M 820,416 V 445 H 970 V 468`},
    {from:"a_pr",  to:"a_pr_yes", type:"yes",  label:"yes"},
    {from:"a_pr",  to:"a_ac",     type:"no",   label:"no"},
  ];

  return renderFlowchart(nodes, edges, "4a. spop OS — unconditional competing risks", 1100, 860);
}
```

### 4b. sample OS — conditional {#sec-sample-os}

The conditional OS path reuses observed event times when available and forecasts only what has not yet been observed.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

chart4b = {
  const nodes = [
    {id:"b_in", x:480, y:55, w:480, h:68, type:"process",
     label:"Inputs: sample T01, conditional T02, observed state",
     sublabel:"T₀₁ = sample_pfs[i]   T₀₂: observed or forecast   state: ms_final_state[i]",
     detail:"Three inputs determined before the routing:\n• T₀₁ = sample_pfs[i] — conditional combined PFS from sections 1–3\n• T₀₂: if !ms_censored_02[i] use ms_time_02[i] (exact); else forecast via survival_time_rng(log_cond_surv_02, pfs[i], 1, 0) starting after pfs[i]\n• T₀₃: not sampled — observed state (ms_final_state[i] == 3) is ground truth for dropout",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1628–1643"},

    {id:"b_drop", x:480, y:165, w:400, h:60, type:"decision",
     label:"sample_dropped_out?",
     sublabel:"ms_final_state[i] == 3",
     detail:"Checks if the patient's observed final state is 3 (dropout / treatment discontinuation). This takes priority over all other routing — an observed dropout cannot be reclassified as a direct death or progression in the conditional path.\n\nThis is the key asymmetry with spop: instead of sampling T₀₃ from the hazard, we use the actual observed state.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1646"},

    {id:"b_died", x:480, y:295, w:400, h:60, type:"decision",
     label:"sample_died_directly?",
     sublabel:"enable_ms_02 && !cens_02 && T₀₂ before T₀₁",
     detail:"sample_died_directly = !dropped_out && enable_ms_02 && !sample_cens_02\n  && (!ms_censored_02 || sample_cens_01 || sample_time_02 < sample_time_01)\n\nKey difference from spop: if the 0→2 death was observed (!ms_censored_02), it always wins the routing (even if T₀₂ > T₀₁) because we condition on the observed event.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1654–1655"},

    {id:"b_prog", x:480, y:415, w:400, h:60, type:"decision",
     label:"sample_progressed_first? && enable_ms_12",
     sublabel:"0→1 first AND post-PD death modeled",
     detail:"sample_progressed_first = !dropped_out && !died_directly && !cens_01\n  && (cens_02 || time_01 ≤ time_02)\n\nProgression wins against an uncensored competing 0→2 only when T₀₁ ≤ T₀₂.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1656–1657"},

    {id:"b_ac", x:480, y:535, w:260, h:60, type:"censored",
     label:"All censored",
     sublabel:"OS = max(T₀₁, T₀₂), censored",
     detail:"sample_os[i] = max(sample_time_01, sample_time_02)\nsample_os_censored[i] = 1\n\nAlso covers progressed_first = 1 but enable_ms_12 = 0.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1691–1694"},

    // ── Dropout sub-cascade (far right) ───────────────────────────────────
    {id:"b_obs32", x:1080, y:165, w:265, h:60, type:"decision",
     label:"!ms_censored_32[i]?",
     sublabel:"Off-trial death observed?",
     detail:"Checks whether an off-trial death was actually observed (ms_censored_32 = 0 means the 3→2 event is recorded). If so, use the exact times directly without sampling.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1660–1663"},

    {id:"b_dobs", x:1080, y:280, w:265, h:60, type:"event",
     label:"OS = ms_time_03 + ms_time_32",
     sublabel:"observed off-trial death, not censored",
     detail:"sample_os[i] = ms_time_03[i] + ms_time_32[i]\nsample_os_censored[i] = 0\n\nms_time_03 is the calendar dropout week (1-indexed).\nms_time_32 is the sojourn from dropout to observed off-trial death.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1661–1663"},

    {id:"b_en32", x:1080, y:395, w:265, h:55, type:"decision",
     label:"enable_ms_32?",
     sublabel:"3→2 transition modeled?",
     detail:"For patients censored for off-trial death: is the 3→2 sojourn GP available? If yes, forecast post-dropout death conditioning on observed sojourn survival. If no, censor OS.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1664–1672"},

    {id:"b_32y", x:960, y:490, w:265, h:68, type:"event",
     label:"sample_dropout_death_rng",
     sublabel:"sojourn_obs = ms_time_32[i]\nConditioned on observed off-trial survival",
     detail:"(sample_os[i], sample_os_censored[i]) = sample_dropout_death_rng(\n  log_cond_surv_32[i], ms_time_03[i], ms_time_32[i])\n\nms_time_32[i] > 0 means the patient survived off-trial for ms_time_32 weeks; the forecast conditions on this observed sojourn.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1666–1668"},

    {id:"b_32n", x:1205, y:490, w:200, h:60, type:"censored",
     label:"No 3→2 model",
     sublabel:"OS = ms_time_03 + ms_time_32\ncensored",
     detail:"sample_os[i] = ms_time_03[i] + ms_time_32[i]\nsample_os_censored[i] = 1\n\nWithout a 3→2 model, OS is censored at the last known off-trial time.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1669–1672"},

    // ── Direct death result (centre-right) ────────────────────────────────
    {id:"b_dout", x:800, y:295, w:220, h:60, type:"event",
     label:"OS = sample_time_02",
     sublabel:"not censored",
     detail:"sample_os[i] = sample_time_02\nsample_os_censored[i] = 0\n\nFor observed 0→2 deaths, sample_time_02 = ms_time_02[i].\nFor forecasted 0→2 deaths, sample_time_02 was drawn from survival_time_rng.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1673–1675"},

    // ── Post-progression sub-cascade (centre-right) ───────────────────────
    {id:"b_cens12", x:820, y:415, w:260, h:60, type:"decision",
     label:"ms_censored_12[i]?",
     sublabel:"Post-PD death not yet observed?",
     detail:"If the post-progression death is censored (ms_censored_12 = 1), we forecast it using the 1→2 sojourn GP conditioned on observed post-PD survival time ms_time_12[i]. If observed (ms_censored_12 = 0), use the exact death time.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1677–1690"},

    {id:"b_pobs", x:720, y:575, w:245, h:60, type:"event",
     label:"OS = pfs[i] + ms_time_12[i]",
     sublabel:"observed post-PD death",
     detail:"sample_os[i] = pfs[i] + ms_time_12[i]\nsample_os_censored[i] = 0\n\nms_time_12[i] is the exact sojourn from progression to observed death.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1678–1680"},

    {id:"b_pfor", x:975, y:575, w:215, h:65, type:"event",
     label:"sample_post_progression_death_rng",
     sublabel:"sojourn_obs = ms_time_12[i]\nConditional on observed post-PD survival",
     detail:"(sample_os[i], sample_os_censored[i]) = sample_post_progression_death_rng(\n  ms_time_scale_12, log_cond_surv_12_s[i], log_cond_surv_12_t[i],\n  sample_time_01, ms_time_12[i])\n\nms_time_12[i] is the observed post-progression survival duration; the GP is conditioned on surviving at least this long.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1682–1690"},
  ];

  const edges = [
    {from:"b_in",   to:"b_drop",  type:"normal"},
    {from:"b_drop", to:"b_obs32", type:"yes",  label:"yes"},
    {from:"b_drop", to:"b_died",  type:"no",   label:"no"},
    {from:"b_obs32",to:"b_dobs",  type:"no",   label:"no (observed)"},
    {from:"b_obs32",to:"b_en32",  type:"yes",  label:"yes",
      path:`M 1080,195 V 367`},
    {from:"b_en32", to:"b_32y",   type:"yes",  label:"yes",
      path:`M 1080,423 V 445 H 960 V 456`},
    {from:"b_en32", to:"b_32n",   type:"no",   label:"no",
      path:`M 1080,423 V 445 H 1205 V 460`},
    {from:"b_died", to:"b_dout",  type:"yes",  label:"yes"},
    {from:"b_died", to:"b_prog",  type:"no",   label:"no"},
    {from:"b_prog", to:"b_cens12",type:"yes",  label:"yes"},
    {from:"b_prog", to:"b_ac",    type:"no",   label:"no"},
    {from:"b_cens12",to:"b_pobs", type:"no",   label:"no (observed)",
      path:`M 820,445 V 510 H 720 V 545`},
    {from:"b_cens12",to:"b_pfor", type:"yes",  label:"yes",
      path:`M 820,445 V 510 H 975 V 542`},
  ];

  return renderFlowchart(nodes, edges, "4b. sample OS — conditional on observed data", 1320, 660);
}
```

## 5. Post-OS PFS Corrections {#sec-pfs-corrections}

After OS is determined, two events retroactively update the PFS arrays: **direct death** (0→2) and **dropout** (0→3).

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

chart5 = {
  const nodes = [
    // ── spop column ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    {id:"e1", x:240, y:108, w:340, h:60, type:"decision",
     label:"spop_died_directly?",
     sublabel:"0→2 fired first in OS simulation",
     detail:"Checks the died_directly flag computed in Section 4a. If true, the spop combined PFS must be updated: the 0→2 death is also a PFS event (OS = PFS for direct deaths).",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1597–1604"},

    {id:"e1_yes", x:240, y:230, w:340, h:68, type:"update",
     label:"Update spop PFS for direct death",
     sublabel:"ms_pfs ← T₀₂, censored ← 0\ncombined PFS = min(target, T₀₂)",
     detail:"spop_ms_pfs[i] = spop_time_02\nspop_ms_right_censored[i] = 0\nspop_pfs[i] = min(spop_target_pfs[i], spop_ms_pfs[i])\nspop_right_censored[i] = spop_target_right_censored[i] && 0\n\nThe direct death 0→2 is simultaneously a PFS event, so the ms component of PFS is updated to the death time.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1598–1603"},

    {id:"e2", x:240, y:360, w:340, h:60, type:"decision",
     label:"spop_dropped_out?",
     sublabel:"0→3 fired first in OS simulation",
     detail:"Checks the dropped_out flag from Section 4a. Dropout (0→3) censors PFS at the dropout time — it is NOT a PFS event. However, if the SLD model predicted progression before dropout, that progression is real.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1607–1620"},

    {id:"e2_sfpd", x:240, y:460, w:340, h:60, type:"decision",
     label:"SLD PD before dropout?",
     sublabel:"!target_rc && target_pfs ≤ T₀₃",
     detail:"Checks if the SLD model predicted progression before the dropout time. If yes, the SLD PD is a real progression event even though the patient dropped out.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1611–1614"},

    {id:"e2_prog", x:150, y:570, w:260, h:65, type:"event",
     label:"PFS = SLD PD time",
     sublabel:"spop_pfs = target_pfs\ncensored = 0",
     detail:"spop_ms_pfs[i] = spop_time_03 (censored at dropout)\nspop_ms_right_censored[i] = 1\nspop_pfs[i] = spop_target_pfs[i]  ← SLD progression event\nspop_right_censored[i] = 0\n\nThe SLD PD occurs before dropout → it's a real progression event.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1612–1614"},

    {id:"e2_cens", x:440, y:570, w:260, h:65, type:"censored",
     label:"PFS = T₀₃, censored",
     sublabel:"spop_pfs = dropout time\ncensored = 1",
     detail:"spop_ms_pfs[i] = spop_time_03 (censored)\nspop_ms_right_censored[i] = 1\nspop_pfs[i] = spop_time_03\nspop_right_censored[i] = 1\n\nNo SLD PD before dropout → PFS is censored at the dropout time.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1615–1619"},

    // ── sample column ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    {id:"f1", x:835, y:108, w:340, h:60, type:"decision",
     label:"sample_died_directly?",
     sublabel:"0→2 fired in conditional OS",
     detail:"Same logic as spop but using the conditional died_directly flag. Key difference: the sample path only updates when the patient was CENSORED for overall PFS (right_censored[i] = 1), because observed progressors already have sample_pfs = pfs[i] set in Section 3.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1697–1703"},

    {id:"f1_yes", x:835, y:230, w:340, h:68, type:"update",
     label:"Update sample PFS for direct death",
     sublabel:"pfs ← T₀₂, ms_pfs ← T₀₂\nboth censored ← 0",
     detail:"sample_pfs[i] = sample_time_02\nsample_right_censored[i] = 0\nsample_ms_pfs[i] = sample_time_02\nsample_ms_right_censored[i] = 0\n\nOnly executed when enable_ms_02 && sample_died_directly.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1698–1703"},

    {id:"f2", x:835, y:360, w:340, h:60, type:"decision",
     label:"sample_dropped_out?",
     sublabel:"ms_final_state[i] == 3",
     detail:"Checks if the patient's observed final state is 3. Same condition used in Section 4b routing.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1705–1719"},

    {id:"f2_sfpd", x:835, y:460, w:340, h:60, type:"decision",
     label:"SLD PD before dropout?",
     sublabel:"!sample_target_rc && target_pfs ≤ ms_time_03",
     detail:"Uses the observed dropout time ms_time_03[i] (not a sampled T₀₃). If SLD predicted PD at or before the actual dropout time, that progression event is real.",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1710–1718"},

    {id:"f2_prog", x:760, y:570, w:265, h:65, type:"event",
     label:"PFS = SLD PD time",
     sublabel:"sample_pfs = sample_target_pfs\ncensored = 0",
     detail:"sample_ms_pfs[i] = ms_time_03[i] (censored at dropout)\nsample_ms_right_censored[i] = 1\nsample_pfs[i] = sample_target_pfs[i]  ← SLD progression\nsample_right_censored[i] = 0",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1711–1713"},

    {id:"f2_cens", x:1050, y:570, w:255, h:65, type:"censored",
     label:"PFS = ms_time_03, censored",
     sublabel:"sample_pfs = dropout week\ncensored = 1",
     detail:"sample_ms_pfs[i] = ms_time_03[i]\nsample_ms_right_censored[i] = 1\nsample_pfs[i] = ms_time_03[i]\nsample_right_censored[i] = 1",
     code:"sf.stanfunctions:1714–1718"},
  ];

  const edges = [
    // spop
    {from:"e1",     to:"e1_yes",  type:"yes", label:"yes", path:`M 240,138 V 196`},
    {from:"e1",     to:"e2",      type:"no",  label:"no",  path:`M 240,138 H 430 V 330 H 240`},
    {from:"e1_yes", to:"e2",      type:"normal"},
    {from:"e2",     to:"e2_sfpd", type:"yes", label:"yes", path:`M 240,390 V 430`},
    {from:"e2_sfpd",to:"e2_prog", type:"yes", label:"yes",
      path:`M 240,490 V 510 H 150 V 537`},
    {from:"e2_sfpd",to:"e2_cens", type:"no",  label:"no",
      path:`M 240,490 V 510 H 440 V 537`},
    // sample
    {from:"f1",     to:"f1_yes",  type:"yes", label:"yes", path:`M 835,138 V 196`},
    {from:"f1",     to:"f2",      type:"no",  label:"no",  path:`M 835,138 H 1025 V 330 H 835`},
    {from:"f1_yes", to:"f2",      type:"normal"},
    {from:"f2",     to:"f2_sfpd", type:"yes", label:"yes", path:`M 835,390 V 430`},
    {from:"f2_sfpd",to:"f2_prog", type:"yes", label:"yes",
      path:`M 835,490 V 510 H 760 V 537`},
    {from:"f2_sfpd",to:"f2_cens", type:"no",  label:"no",
      path:`M 835,490 V 510 H 1050 V 537`},
  ];

  return renderFlowchart(nodes, edges, "5. Post-OS PFS Corrections", 1200, 670);
}
```

## 6. CIF Reclassification {#sec-cif-reclassification}

Before the CIF module runs, `spop_ms_pfs` is reclassified to ensure the CIF correctly attributes each patient's first state-0 exit across all three causes.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

chart6 = {
  const nodes = [
    {id:"g_in", x:440, y:55, w:460, h:60, type:"process",
     label:"For each patient: check spop PFS flags",
     sublabel:"spop_right_censored, spop_target_right_censored, spop_target_pfs, spop_ms_pfs",
     detail:"This loop runs after all OS computations. It reclassifies spop_ms_pfs[i] so that the CIF counting module in generated_quantities.stan can correctly classify each patient's cause of first state-0 exit.",
     code:"_endpoints_generated_quantities.stan:378–389"},

    {id:"g_case1", x:440, y:155, w:460, h:60, type:"decision",
     label:"spop_right_censored[i] == 0?",
     sublabel:"PFS event reached (state 1 or 2)",
     detail:"A combined PFS event occurred — the patient reached state 1 (progression) or state 2 (direct death). In this case, spop_ms_pfs should track the combined PFS time so the CIF module counts this patient at the right time.",
     code:"_endpoints_generated_quantities.stan:379–382"},

    {id:"g_c1_yes", x:440, y:265, w:460, h:60, type:"update",
     label:"spop_ms_pfs = spop_pfs[i]",
     sublabel:"Use combined PFS time for CIF counting",
     detail:"Sets spop_ms_pfs[i] = spop_pfs[i] (the combined minimum). This handles the case where an SLD-driven progression (target component) was the first exit — the ms component alone would not have it, but the combined PFS does.",
     code:"_endpoints_generated_quantities.stan:381–382"},

    {id:"g_case2", x:440, y:375, w:460, h:60, type:"decision",
     label:"SLD PD before dropout?",
     sublabel:"!target_rc && target_pfs ≤ ms_pfs",
     detail:"Checks if the patient is a state-3 patient (spop_right_censored = 1, meaning the first visible exit was dropout) but where the SLD model predicts progression BEFORE the dropout time. In the full joint model, such a patient actually progressed first — their dropout is a consequence, not the first state-0 exit.",
     code:"_endpoints_generated_quantities.stan:383–386"},

    {id:"g_c2_yes", x:440, y:478, w:460, h:60, type:"update",
     label:"spop_ms_pfs = spop_target_pfs",
     sublabel:"Reclassify as 0→1 progression",
     detail:"Sets spop_ms_pfs[i] = spop_target_pfs[i] and spop_ms_right_censored[i] = 0.\n\nThis reclassifies the patient from '0→3 dropout' to '0→1 progression' for the CIF. The SLD mechanism predicts progression before dropout → the joint model says progression was the true first exit.",
     code:"_endpoints_generated_quantities.stan:385–386"},

    {id:"g_else", x:440, y:572, w:460, h:55, type:"censored",
     label:"Leave spop_ms_pfs unchanged",
     sublabel:"State 3 or fully censored — no reclassification",
     detail:"Dropout with SLD PD after dropout time, or fully censored patients: the CIF module will classify them as 0→3 or fully censored based on spop_ms_pfs / spop_ms_right_censored as-is.",
     code:"_endpoints_generated_quantities.stan:388"},
  ];

  const edges = [
    {from:"g_in",    to:"g_case1",  type:"normal"},
    {from:"g_case1", to:"g_c1_yes", type:"yes", label:"yes", path:`M 440,185 V 235`},
    {from:"g_case1", to:"g_case2",  type:"no",  label:"no"},
    {from:"g_c1_yes",to:"g_case2",  type:"normal"},
    {from:"g_case2", to:"g_c2_yes", type:"yes", label:"yes", path:`M 440,405 V 448`},
    {from:"g_case2", to:"g_else",   type:"no",  label:"no"},
    {from:"g_c2_yes",to:"g_else",   type:"normal"},
  ];

  return renderFlowchart(nodes, edges, "6. CIF Reclassification — first state-0 exit attribution", 1100, 660);
}
```

## 7. CIF Computation {#sec-cif-computation}

After reclassification, the cumulative incidence functions are computed per trial by counting events at each time point and normalizing.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

chart7 = {
  const nodes = [
    {id:"h_in", x:440, y:55, w:480, h:60, type:"process",
     label:"For each trial s: initialize count arrays",
     sublabel:"cnt_s01, cnt_s02, cnt_s03 (spop)   cnt_sm01, cnt_sm02, cnt_sm03 (sample)",
     detail:"Six integer arrays of length max_all_t + 1 are initialized to zero. Each array counts events of one type at each calendar week. Separate spop and sample arrays allow both pathways to be computed in the same loop.",
     code:"multistate/generated_quantities.stan:37–42"},

    {id:"h_class", x:440, y:155, w:480, h:60, type:"process",
     label:"Classify each patient's first state-0 exit",
     sublabel:"For j in tr_start:tr_end — per-patient classification",
     detail:"For each patient in the trial:\n• spop_right_censored == 0 && pfs == os: cnt_s02[pfs] += 1  (0→2 direct death)\n• spop_right_censored == 0 otherwise:   cnt_s01[pfs] += 1  (0→1 progression)\n• spop_right_censored == 1 && pfs ≤ max_all_t: cnt_s03[pfs] += 1  (0→3 dropout)\n• else: no contribution (fully censored, pfs > max_all_t)\n\nSame logic applied to sample arrays using sample_pfs, sample_os, sample_right_censored.",
     code:"multistate/generated_quantities.stan:44–70"},

    {id:"h_01", x:175, y:270, w:220, h:55, type:"event",
     label:"cnt_s01[T] += 1",
     sublabel:"0→1 progression",
     detail:"PFS event but OS and PFS times differ → patient progressed, death came later (or hasn't yet). T = spop_pfs[j].",
     code:"multistate/generated_quantities.stan:53"},

    {id:"h_02", x:440, y:270, w:220, h:55, type:"event",
     label:"cnt_s02[T] += 1",
     sublabel:"0→2 direct death",
     detail:"PFS event AND os_censored == 0 AND pfs_time == os_time → patient died without progressing, death is the first state-0 exit. T = spop_pfs[j].",
     code:"multistate/generated_quantities.stan:51"},

    {id:"h_03", x:705, y:270, w:220, h:55, type:"censored",
     label:"cnt_s03[T] += 1",
     sublabel:"0→3 dropout",
     detail:"PFS censored (spop_right_censored == 1) but pfs ≤ max_all_t → patient dropped out within the observation window. T = spop_pfs[j].",
     code:"multistate/generated_quantities.stan:55–56"},

    {id:"h_cumsum", x:440, y:380, w:480, h:60, type:"process",
     label:"Cumulative sum → normalized CIF",
     sublabel:"for t in 1:max_all_t+1 — running sum / n_tr",
     detail:"Running cumulative sum over the count arrays, normalized by the number of patients in the trial:\n\ncif_01[s][t] = (Σ cnt_s01[1:t]) / n_tr\ncif_02[s][t] = (Σ cnt_s02[1:t]) / n_tr\ncif_03[s][t] = (Σ cnt_s03[1:t]) / n_tr\n\nThis gives the empirical sub-distribution CIF: fraction of patients with each cause by week t.",
     code:"multistate/generated_quantities.stan:72–84"},

    {id:"h_out", x:440, y:475, w:480, h:60, type:"event",
     label:"Output: spop_cif_01/02/03, sample_cif_01/02/03",
     sublabel:"Per-trial vectors of length max_all_t + 1",
     detail:"Six arrays of vectors, one per transition type per pathway. Each element [s][t] is the fraction of trial-s patients with that cause by calendar week t.\n\nThe CIF vectors sum to ≤ 1 at any time point across all three causes (remaining probability is fully censored). The CIF is indexed 1-based matching the KM vector convention.",
     code:"multistate/generated_quantities.stan:78–84"},
  ];

  const edges = [
    {from:"h_in",    to:"h_class",  type:"normal"},
    {from:"h_class", to:"h_01",     type:"yes",  label:"0→1",
      path:`M 400,185 V 215 H 175 V 242`},
    {from:"h_class", to:"h_02",     type:"yes",  label:"0→2",
      path:`M 440,185 V 242`},
    {from:"h_class", to:"h_03",     type:"yes",  label:"0→3",
      path:`M 480,185 V 215 H 705 V 242`},
    {from:"h_01",    to:"h_cumsum", type:"normal",
      path:`M 175,297 V 340 H 440 V 350`},
    {from:"h_02",    to:"h_cumsum", type:"normal"},
    {from:"h_03",    to:"h_cumsum", type:"normal",
      path:`M 705,297 V 340 H 440 V 350`},
    {from:"h_cumsum",to:"h_out",    type:"normal"},
  ];

  return renderFlowchart(nodes, edges, "7. CIF Computation — empirical subdistribution", 1100, 570);
}
```
